Name: Class Teacher First Period Allocation
Description: Whenever an allocated teaching session of the class teacher is scheduled in their assigned class, it must be placed in Period 1. If the class teacher has >= 6 periods allocated in their class, all 6 Period 1 slots are filled by them. If the class teacher has 0 allocated teaching periods in that class (e.g. Teacher SL in V-D), no artificial substitute assignments are invented and this is reported as an upstream data defect.
MathematicalFormulation: forall d in Days, forall a in Alloc(c, ClassTeacher(c)): sum_{p=2..8} x_{c,d,p,a} = 0

Name: Maximum Two Continuous Lectures Per Teacher
Description: A teacher can teach at most 2 consecutive periods within any continuous session. Recess between Period 4 and Period 5 resets consecutive counting.
MathematicalFormulation: forall t in Teachers, forall d in Days, forall p in {1,2,5,6}: sum_{k=0..2} is_teaching(t,d,p+k) <= 2

Name: Single Assignment Per Class Slot
Description: Exactly one subject-teacher assignment is scheduled in every slot for every class. Validated dynamically during input validation because each class has exactly 48 required periods filling the 6x8 grid.
MathematicalFormulation: forall c in Classes, forall d in Days, forall p in Periods: sum_{a in Allocations(c)} x_{c,d,p,a} = 1

Name: Single Class Per Teacher Slot
Description: A teacher can teach at most one class in any given time slot.
MathematicalFormulation: forall t in Teachers, forall d in Days, forall p in Periods: sum_{c in Classes} sum_{a in Allocations(c,t)} x_{c,d,p,a} <= 1

Name: Computer Lab Exclusivity
Description: Across all 26 classes, at most one class may use the single Computer Lab in any slot (d,p).
MathematicalFormulation: forall d in Days, forall p in Periods: sum_{c in Classes} sum_{a in LabAllocations(c)} x_{c,d,p,a} <= 1

Name: Physical Education Prohibited in Period 1
Description: Physical Education (P.E.) cannot be scheduled in Period 1 for any class.
MathematicalFormulation: forall c in Classes, forall d in Days: sum_{a in PE_Allocations(c)} x_{c,d,p=1,a} = 0

Name: Physical Education Prohibited Immediately After Recess
Description: Physical Education (P.E.) cannot be scheduled in Period 5 (immediately following the 09:30-09:50 recess) for any class.
MathematicalFormulation: forall c in Classes, forall d in Days: sum_{a in PE_Allocations(c)} x_{c,d,p=5,a} = 0

Name: Maximum Two Activity Periods Per Class Per Day
Description: A class can have at most 2 activity/co-curricular periods on any given day. Activity subjects are defined in configuration.
MathematicalFormulation: forall c in Classes, forall d in Days: sum_{p=1..8} sum_{a in ActivityAllocations(c)} x_{c,d,p,a} <= 2

Name: Exact Granular Allotment Fulfillment
Description: Every atomic (Class, Subject, Teacher) required period count must be exactly satisfied, and the total scheduled slots across the school must exactly equal 1,248.
MathematicalFormulation: forall a=(c,t,s,K): sum_{d=1..6} sum_{p=1..8} x_{c,d,p,a} = K AND sum_{all} K = 1248

Name: P.E. and Computer Same-Day Partition Around Recess
Description: When both P.E. and Computer are scheduled on the same day for a class, one must be in Periods 1-4 and the other in Periods 5-8. (PE in 1-4 AND Comp in 5-8) OR (Comp in 1-4 AND PE in 5-8).
MathematicalFormulation: forall c, forall d: sum_{p=1..4} x_{c,d,p,PE} + sum_{p=1..4} x_{c,d,p,Comp} <= 1 AND sum_{p=5..8} x_{c,d,p,PE} + sum_{p=5..8} x_{c,d,p,Comp} <= 1

Name: Subject Distribution Across the Week
Description: Multi-period subjects should be distributed evenly across distinct days (at most 1 lecture/day for K<=6, at most 2 for K>6).

Name: Non-Consecutive Days for Two-Period Subjects
Description: Subjects with exactly 2 periods/week should not be scheduled on consecutive days (target gap >= 2 days).
MathematicalFormulation: minimize sum_{c,s with K=2, d in {1..5}} (has_lesson(c,s,d) * has_lesson(c,s,d+1))

Name: Spacing Between Repeated Subject Lectures
Description: Reward balanced spacing and penalize tight clustering of repeated subject sessions across the week.
MathematicalFormulation: minimize clustering penalty between successive lecture days

Name: Teacher Daily Workload Balance
Description: Minimize daily teaching load variance for each teacher around their weekly average load / 6.

Name: Teacher Idle Gap Minimization
Description: Minimize unassigned idle window periods between a teacher's first and last period of each day.

Name: Class Academic Variety and Sequencing
Description: Avoid clustering more than 3 consecutive heavy academic periods without a co-curricular or linguistic break.
